epics.title: Synchronous Physical DOCX/CSV Generation, File Registry & Anti-Hallucination Download Links
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator or faculty member asks the CRIE assistant for a downloadable DOCX reference or CSV/Excel table, I want the backend to synchronously generate the physical file, persist its hash in SQLite, verify it exists on disk, and inject the real URL into a dedicated prompt slot, so that every download link actually works and the LLM never fabricates broken links.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 0% hallucinated download URLs and 100% HTTP 200 physical file resolution for export-intent requests
epics.tocConstraintRef: LLM fabricating unbacked /crie/api/download/... URLs before or without physical file creation on disk
requirements: R1: Detect file-export intent in user chat queries via deterministic triggers (file, download, link, DOCX, official reference, Excel/CSV table) and resolve the target format (DOCX vs CSV).

R2: Implement synchronous physical DOCX and CSV generation in crie_document_engine.py writing structured artifacts (including official 2027 KCP reference DOCX documents exceeding 10 KB and UTF-8 CSV tables) to the exports directory.
R3: Persist generated export metadata in a SQLite file-registry table storing unique filename, SHA-256 hash, format, MIME type, byte size, and creation timestamp.

R4: Verify os.path.exists() and non-zero file size before binding /crie/api/download/<real_filename> to the [GENERATED_FILE_URL] slot, and return an explicit generation-failure notice without any download link if file creation or disk verification fails.

R5: Update system prompts in crie_regulatory_canon.py and crie_thought_agent.py to strictly prohibit LLM self-generation of /crie/api/download/... strings unless injected via [GENERATED_FILE_URL], enforced by a server-side post-processor that strips unverified download links.

R6: Harden GET /crie/api/download/{filename} in crie_assistant_api.py with path-traversal protection, accurate MIME types (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document for .docx and text/csv; charset=utf-8 for .csv), and HTTP 200 streaming.

R7: Cover intent detection, SQLite hash registration, prompt/post-processor URL guard, and end-to-end 2027 KCP DOCX generation plus GET /crie/api/download/{filename} MIME and >10 KB size verification with automated tests.

slices.acceptanceCriteria:

slices.tocConstraintRef: Unindexed or unverified files in generated_documents/ lacking persistent hash provenance
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of registered export rows match on-disk SHA-256 digest and byte size

slices.jtbd: When implementing LLM prompt grounding for this epic, I want explicit system prompt prohibitions and a response post-processor for [GENERATED_FILE_URL], so that the model never invents /crie/api/download/... URLs.
